jobs.title: Древний реликварий Эхо (r5): пламя в кристалле без «S»
jobs.subject: Inside the big central red crystal burns an orange flame shaped like a curled S-swirl. Repaint only that flame: make it one single upright tongue of fire — a simple teardrop flame, wide and round at the bottom, narrowing to one soft point at the top, glowing hot yellow-orange at its heart and fading into the red of the crystal at its edges, like a candle flame trapped in a gem. No curl, no spiral, no hook, no loop, nothing that looks like a letter, a digit or a sign. Everything else stays exactly the same.
